d: An influencer, Dina, makes a bet she can get a guy to dump her for a video. Unbeknownst to her, the guy, Aaron, has a bet he can make her fall for him to win money. As they try to manipulate each other, they fall in love. They reveal their painful pasts and realize their feelings are genuine.

Lexi has daily amnesia, waking with no memory of the previous day. Her boyfriend, Cooper, and best friend, Ari, help her cope, but secrets from her past—and a shocking betrayal—unravel as Lexi slowly regains her memory.

t: Girl Wakes Up as Most Hated Student
d: When her mean private texts leak, popular Addison loses her friends. After cheating to win Homecoming Queen, she confesses publicly and reconciles with her ex-best friend, Ruby.

t: Popular Girl Only Has All Robot Friends
d: Tired of being rejected, brilliant student Brielle builds a squad of perfect robot best friends. But when the AI turns against her to expose the whole school, she must team up with her human ex-BFF.

t: Vegan Teacher Bans All Meat on Thanksgiving
d: Ms. Klemper, a militant vegan teacher, rigs a school vote to ban meat following her brother's death. After her extreme methods cause a riot, she learns that forced change only breeds resentment.

t: Girl Can't See Family on Thanksgiving
d: After job loss and a grounded flight ruin her Puerto Rican Thanksgiving plans, Analeese launches a DIY business with friends' help. They surprise her with a home-cooked feast and family FaceTime.
Siblings Randle and Jessie drop the turkey in a mop bucket and steal a replacement from a lady at the store. Their cover is blown when the victim arrives at dinner as their dad's secretary.

t: Girl Goes Viral Then Her Family Controls Her Life
d: After going viral for her dancing, Sara's struggling family tries to turn her success into a monetized brand, forcing her to choose between financial fame and her dream dance audition.

Juvenile delinquent Mikey schemes to steal church offerings, but a real thief gets there first. When the money goes missing, Mikey helps expose the deceitful Pastor, earns a reward, and uses it to help a sick child.

t: Teen's First Job Goes Very Wrong
d: Teen Lamar attempts dangerous TikTok stunts to gain followers and win Lisa's attention. A near-fatal challenge lands him in the hospital, forcing him to shift his focus to mental health and genuine connection, leading to real success.

t: Problem Child Gets World's Strictest Babysitter
d: After Sasha hangs a bully from a flagpole, her father hires a strict babysitter to discipline her. Sasha tries to rebel, but eventually learns respect before being sent to live in a tiny house.

t: Two School Pranksters Go Way Too Far
d: After their mean pranks go too far, pranksters Frank and Jake are forced by their victims to change their ways. They start a viral "kindness prank" channel, proving that humor can be used for good.

t: Genius Boy Is Kicked Out From Party
d: Competitive mom Brenda bans Jayden from her son's party for being "too good" at everything. After guests boycott her event for Jayden's, the moms realize kids' friendships shouldn't suffer for parent petty rivalries.

t: Kid Steals First Ever PlayStation 6, He Lives to Regret It
d: Eddy breaks into a store to steal a PS6, but only snags an empty display box. After leaving his backpack behind, he's arrested and loses the real console his mom had already hidden for him.
